machine_checks.note: Machine checks are NOT review. They prove quotes exist verbatim in the archived sources and the file loads - not that the encoding means what the sources mean.

quotes.quote: # Not required for students pursuing a major in Electrical and Computer Engineering

# Not required for students pursuing a major in Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering (Class of 2030+), Civil Engineering (Class of 2030+), Industrial Engineering (Class of 2030+), or Mechanical Engineering (Class of 2030+).

review_questions: Link guide for Phase C: ECE never links this; Aerospace, Civil, Industrial and Mechanical link it only in their classes-before-2030 curricula; every other major links it in both. Confirm.
what_to_verify: Open each archived source (paths below) and find every quoted sentence.
For each node, confirm the encoding says what its quote says: courses, counts, levels, grade floors, credit minimums, stages.
Confirm nothing the sources require is missing - compare with 'rules not yet modeled' and 'unknowns'.
Resolve or explicitly accept each OPEN conflict; never pick a side silently.
Confirm admission/declaration rules are entry-stage requirements or labels, never completion requirements, and that no plan would assume admission.
Answer every review question; 'changes requested' is a valid outcome.
how_to_record: Components have no review command yet: record the decision in the PR / review notes; the component stays 'pending_review' (and every audit and index label says so) until a component review command exists.
